simple.meaning: מִכְלָאָה (miklâʼâh) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a pen (for flocks).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H4356. miklaah or miklah I. מִכְלָה (incorrect for מכלא ) noun [masculine] enclosure, fold ; — מִמּ ׳גָּזַר צאֹן Hab 3:17 ; plural construct צאֹן מִמִּכְלְאֹת לקח Psa 78:70 (object David); plural suffix מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ לקח 50:9 (object he-goats). — II. מִכְלָה see below כלה .
